stories.headline: VMware has quietly walked its SmartNIC ambitions
stories.summary: VMware has quietly stopped selling its NSX distributed firewalls designed for SmartNICs, also known as data processing units (DPUs). This move represents a retreat from VMware's previous strategy of encouraging private cloud customers to adopt hyperscale-style hardware architectures to offload networking and security tasks. While the company had adapted its hypervisor to run on DPUs, the offering ultimately failed to generate sufficient customer interest.

stories.headline: Failed networking vendor Cambium set to turn off its cloudy management portal
stories.summary: Networking hardware vendor Cambium Networks has entered administration and warned customers that its cloud management services will likely be shut down soon. The company has ceased production of its Wi-Fi access points, NSE firewalls, and cnMatrix switches, and has laid off over half of its workforce. Customers are advised to transition to on-premises management software as soon as possible.

stories.headline: She’s Apples for Albo on US trip to talk social media, algorithms and AI
stories.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese met with Apple CEO Tim Cook in California to discuss artificial intelligence regulations, algorithm opt-outs, and child safety features. The discussions follow Australia's legislative push for a social media ban for children under 16 and its efforts to establish international AI guardrails.

stories.headline: Moneyview Sets ₹32-₹34 Price Band For ₹1,092 Cr IPO
stories.summary: Indian fintech startup Moneyview has set the price band for its upcoming ₹1,092 crore initial public offering at ₹32 to ₹34 per equity share. The Accel-backed digital lending platform is among a growing number of Indian tech startups preparing to list on the public markets.

stories.headline: VinFast’s ride-hailing arm Green SM takes on Jakarta’s ojek economy with e-scooters
stories.summary: Green SM, the ride-hailing arm of Vietnamese EV manufacturer VinFast, has launched an electric motorbike service in Jakarta, Indonesia. This marks the company's first two-wheeled mobility expansion outside of Vietnam, positioning it as a direct competitor to regional ride-hailing giants Grab and Gojek.

stories.headline: Ant International Launches Industry’s First Full-Stack AI-Native Solutions for Payment, Account, FX, Treasury and Growth Operations for Global Businesses
stories.summary: Ant International has launched a suite of AI-native solutions designed for global businesses, covering payments, accounts, FX, treasury, and growth operations. The product suite is built on a two-layered security architecture and utilizes two proprietary foundation models, including the Antom 3-in-1 Transformer.

stories.headline: ITM Semiconductor’s Vietnam unit hit by fraud and widening losses
stories.summary: ITM Semiconductor's Vietnamese subsidiary is facing widening financial losses alongside an ongoing employee embezzlement investigation. The South Korean battery components manufacturer disclosed that it has recovered approximately US$2.47 million of the embezzled funds, though the unit's overall financial performance has sharply deteriorated.
